## Load libraries and set path

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(egg)
library(easyr)

here("palmer-carb-qc")

```
## Read in 2020 data

```{r}

pal2020 <- read_excel('LMG20-01_carbonate_summary.xlsx')

pal2020 <- pal2020 %>%
   rename(DIC_umolkg = "DIC_avg _umolkg-1",
         TA_umolkg = "TA_umolkg-1",
         Salinity_psu = "Salinity_to_use") 

pal2020 <- pal2020 %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(Depth != "underway" ~ "Niskin",
                          TRUE ~ Depth))  %>%
  mutate(depth = case_when(type == "underway" ~ "0",
                         TRUE ~ Depth))  

pal2020$Depth <- as.numeric(pal2020$Depth)
pal2020$year <- as.factor(year(pal2020$Date))

```

## Read in 2023 data

```{r}

pal2023 <- read_xlsx('LMG23-01_carbonate_summary_draft.xlsx')

pal2023 <- pal2023 %>%
  rename(Salinity_psu = "Salinity_primary") %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date)) 

pal2023$Time_UTC <- as.character(pal2023$Time_UTC)
pal2023$Time_UTC <- right(pal2023$Time_UTC, 8) 

pal2023 <- pal2023 |>
    mutate(Time_UTC = case_when(Time_UTC == "00-01-01" ~ "00:00:00", TRUE ~ Time_UTC)) |>
    mutate(Time_UTC = case_when(Time_UTC == "01-12-25" ~ "00:00:00", TRUE ~ Time_UTC)) |>
    mutate(Time_UTC = case_when(Time_UTC == "03-01-01" ~ "00:00:00", TRUE ~ Time_UTC)) 

pal2023 <- pal2023 |>
  mutate(type = case_when(Depth != "UW" ~ "Niskin",
                          Depth == "UW" ~ "underway"
                          )) |>
  mutate(Depth = case_when(Depth == "UW" ~ "0",
                         TRUE ~ Depth))  

pal2023$Depth <- as.numeric(pal2023$Depth)
pal2023$year <- as.factor(pal2023$year)

```

## Read in 2024 data

```{r}

pal2024 <- read_csv('LMG24-01_carbonate_summary_draft.csv')

pal2024 <- pal2024 |>
  rename(Salinity_psu = "Salinity_primary") |>
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) |>
  mutate(TA_Analysis_Date = mdy(TA_Analysis_Date)) |>
  mutate(DIC_Analysis_Date = mdy(DIC_Analysis_Date))
  

pal2024 <- pal2024 |>
  mutate(type = case_when(Depth != "underway" ~ "Niskin",
                          Depth == "underway" ~ "underway"
                          ))  |>
  mutate(Depth = case_when(Depth == "underway" ~ "0",
                         TRUE ~ Depth))  

pal2024$Depth <- as.numeric(pal2024$Depth)
pal2024$year <- as.factor(pal2024$year)

```

## Read in, clean, and plot historical data

```{r}

# run knb-lter-pal.44.8.r downloaded from the EDI Data Portal
# temporal coverage 1993-2019

#source("knb-lter-pal.44.8.r")

historical <- read_csv("D44_CruiseDIC_1993to2019.csv")

#historical <- dt1 

historical <- historical %>%
  mutate(DIC1 = replace(DIC1, DIC1 <0, NA)) %>%  ## to replace -9.0
  mutate(Alkalinity2 = replace(Alkalinity2, Alkalinity2 <0, NA)) %>%  ## to replace -999 
  mutate(Salinity = replace(Salinity, Salinity < 0, NA))  ## to replace -999

# examine outlying values
lowalk <- subset(historical, Alkalinity1 < 2000 | Alkalinity2 < 2000) # note one observation Alkalinity.1 = 10 umol/kg
lowdic <- subset(historical, DIC1 < 1800 | DIC2 < 1800)
lowsal <- subset(historical, Salinity < 1)

# prepare for plotting

# rename columns to match pal2020
historical <- historical %>% 
    rename(Salinity_psu = Salinity,
           DIC_umolkg = DIC1,
           TA_umolkg = Alkalinity1) %>% 
    mutate(type = "historical") 

historical$year <- as.factor(year(historical$DatetimeGMT))

# eliminate some oddly low values from 1996 
# one low alkalinity of 10, two samples with DIC of 1212 and 1225 umol/kg
historical <- historical %>% 
    filter (TA_umolkg > 10) %>%
    filter (DIC_umolkg > 1500)

histund <- historical %>% filter(BottleNumber == "UW")
histNiskin <- historical %>% filter(BottleNumber != "UW")

```


```{r} 

# plot dic and ta 
# note: plotting only DIC1, and Alkalinity1, not DIC2 and Alkalinity2
ggplot(historical, aes(x= Salinity_psu, y = DIC_umolkg, color = -Depth))+ geom_point()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by depth and salinity")
ggplot(historical, aes(x= Salinity_psu, y = TA_umolkg, color = -Depth))+ geom_point()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by depth and salinity")
ggplot(historical, aes(x= DIC_umolkg, y = -Depth, color = Salinity_psu))+ geom_point()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by depth and salinity")
ggplot(historical, aes(x= TA_umolkg, y = -Depth, color = Salinity_psu))+ geom_point()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by depth and salinity")

ggplot(historical, aes(x= DIC_umolkg, y = -Depth, color = year))+ geom_point()+scale_colour_viridis_d()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by depth and year")
ggplot(historical, aes(x= TA_umolkg, y = -Depth, color = year))+ geom_point()+scale_colour_viridis_d()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by depth and year")
ggplot(historical, aes(x= Salinity_psu, y = DIC_umolkg, color = year))+ geom_point()+scale_colour_viridis_d()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by salinity and year")
ggplot(historical, aes(x= Salinity_psu, y = TA_umolkg, color = year))+ geom_point()+ scale_colour_viridis_d()+labs(title = "Palmer historical by salinity and year")

ggplot(histund, aes(x= Salinity_psu, y = DIC_umolkg, color = year))+ geom_point()+scale_colour_viridis_d()+labs(title = "Palmer historical underway samples")
ggplot(histund, aes(x= NominalStation, y = DIC_umolkg, color = year))+ geom_point()+scale_colour_viridis_d()+labs(title = "Palmer historical underway samples by station")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```

# Examine replicates

```{r}

#replicates <- read_excel("LMG20-01_carbonate_replicates.xlsx")

pal2020$replicate_id <- paste0(pal2020$Station, "-", pal2020$Depth)
pal2023$replicate_id <- paste0(pal2023$Station, "-", pal2023$Depth)
pal2024$replicate_id <- paste0(pal2024$Station, "-", pal2024$Depth)

rep_2020 <- pal2020  |> 
  group_by(replicate_id) |>
  summarize(dic_avg = mean(DIC_umolkg),
            dic_sd = sd(DIC_umolkg),
            ta_avg = mean(TA_umolkg),
            ta_sd = sd(TA_umolkg))


rep_2023 <- pal2023  |> 
  group_by(replicate_id) |>
  summarize(dic_avg = mean(DIC_umolkg),
            dic_sd = sd(DIC_umolkg),
            ta_avg = mean(TA_umolkg),
            ta_sd = sd(TA_umolkg))

rep_2024 <- pal2024  |> 
  group_by(replicate_id) |>
  summarize(dic_avg = mean(DIC_umolkg),
            dic_sd = sd(DIC_umolkg),
            ta_avg = mean(TA_umolkg),
            ta_sd = sd(TA_umolkg))

rep_2023$station <- left(rep_2023$replicate_id, 7)
#rep_2023$depth <- right(rep_2023$replicate_id, 2)
rep_2024$station <- left(rep_2024$replicate_id, 7)

rep_2020$dic_lower <- rep_2020$dic_avg - rep_2020$dic_sd
rep_2020$dic_upper <- rep_2020$dic_avg + rep_2020$dic_sd
rep_2023$dic_lower <- rep_2023$dic_avg - rep_2023$dic_sd
rep_2023$dic_upper <- rep_2023$dic_avg + rep_2023$dic_sd
rep_2024$dic_lower <- rep_2024$dic_avg - rep_2024$dic_sd
rep_2024$dic_upper <- rep_2024$dic_avg + rep_2024$dic_sd

rep_2020$ta_lower <- rep_2020$ta_avg - rep_2020$ta_sd
rep_2020$ta_upper <- rep_2020$ta_avg + rep_2020$ta_sd
rep_2023$ta_lower <- rep_2023$ta_avg - rep_2023$ta_sd
rep_2023$ta_upper <- rep_2023$ta_avg + rep_2023$ta_sd
rep_2024$ta_lower <- rep_2024$ta_avg - rep_2024$ta_sd
rep_2024$ta_upper <- rep_2024$ta_avg + rep_2024$ta_sd

ggplot(rep_2020, aes(x= replicate_id, y = dic_avg))+ geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dic_lower, ymax = dic_upper), width = 0.2)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+labs(title = "LMG20-01 DIC replicate average and standard deviation")
ggplot(rep_2020, aes(x= replicate_id, y = ta_avg))+ geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ta_lower, ymax = ta_upper), width = 0.2)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+labs(title = "LMG20-01 TA replicate average and standard deviation")
ggplot(rep_2023, aes(x= station, y = dic_avg))+ geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dic_lower, ymax = dic_upper), width = 0.2)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+labs(title = "LMG23-01 DIC replicate average and standard deviation")
ggplot(rep_2023, aes(x= station, y = ta_avg))+ geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ta_lower, ymax = ta_upper), width = 0.2)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+labs(title = "LMG23-01 TA replicate average and standard deviation")
ggplot(rep_2024, aes(x= station, y = dic_avg))+ geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dic_lower, ymax = dic_upper), width = 0.2)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+labs(title = "LMG24-01 DIC replicate average and standard deviation")
ggplot(rep_2024, aes(x= station, y = ta_avg))+ geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ta_lower, ymax = ta_upper), width = 0.2)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+labs(title = "LMG24-01 TA replicate average and standard deviation")

# ggplot(replicates, aes(x= TA_umolkg, y = TA_diff_replicates, color = Depth))+ geom_point()
```

## Format data for submitting

```{r}

# regularize columns

headers <- c("Date", "Time_UTC", "Station", "Depth", "Salinity_psu", "TA_umolkg", "TA_sd", "DIC_umolkg", "DIC_sd", "ID", "initial_flag", "Comment", "type", "replicate_id")

pub2023 <- pal2023[, headers]
pub2024 <- pal2024[, headers]

pub2023$Cruise_ID <- "LMG23-01"
pub2024$Cruise_ID <- "LMG24-01"

pal2024$Time_UTC <- as.character(pal2024$Time_UTC)

pub2023 <- pub2023 |>
  rename(Sample_ID = ID) |> 
  rename(TA_umol_per_kg = TA_umolkg) |>
  rename(TA_std_dev = TA_sd) |>
  rename(DIC_umol_per_kg = DIC_umolkg) |>
  rename(DIC_std_dev = DIC_sd) |>
  rename(Processing_flag = initial_flag) |>
  rename(Processing_Notes = Comment) |>
  rename(Type = type) |> 
  rename(Replicate_ID = replicate_id)

pub2023 <- pub2023 |>
  mutate(across(c(DIC_umol_per_kg, DIC_std_dev, TA_umol_per_kg, TA_std_dev), round, digits = 1))

pub2024 <- pub2024 |>
  rename(Sample_ID = ID) |> 
  rename(TA_umol_per_kg = TA_umolkg) |>
  rename(TA_std_dev = TA_sd) |>
  rename(DIC_umol_per_kg = DIC_umolkg) |>
  rename(DIC_std_dev = DIC_sd) |>
  rename(Processing_flag = initial_flag) |>
  rename(Processing_Notes = Comment) |>
  rename(Type = type) |> 
  rename(Replicate_ID = replicate_id)

pub2024 <- pub2024 |>
  mutate(across(c(DIC_umol_per_kg, DIC_std_dev, TA_umol_per_kg, TA_std_dev), round, digits = 1))

headers <- c("Cruise_ID", "Date", "Time_UTC", "Station", "Depth", "Sample_ID", "Salinity_psu", "DIC_umol_per_kg", "DIC_std_dev", "TA_umol_per_kg", "TA_std_dev",  "Processing_flag", "Processing_Notes", "Type", "Replicate_ID")

pub2023 <- pub2023[, headers]
pub2024 <- pub2024[, headers]

write_csv(pub2023, "LMG23-01_carbonate_summary.csv")
write_csv(pub2024, "LMG24-01_carbonate_summary.csv")

```
